signals.summary: Remake Tohno Shiki includes Tohno Shiki and Nanaya Shiki as names, and is categorized as human demon-hunter and psychic; a half-vampire/Dead Apostle status is limited to the Ciel-line Extra End signal.
The source provides age, height, weight, birthday, blood type, birthplace at the Nanaya home, activity area in Souya City, and Tohno family affiliation.
Remake Tohno Shiki has Direct Death Mystic Eyes from an earlier event, letting him see death and kill all things.
He normally wears Mystic Eye Killer glasses to suppress the eyes and avoid excessive brain burden.
His true identity is the last descendant of the Nanaya demon-hunter family, found by Tohno Makihisa after the Nanaya family was destroyed by the Tohno family.

The assigned Tohno-Nanaya source excerpt does not provide a direct remake activation scene or remake combat use scene for Shiki's eyes; the Arcueid profile provides the remake seventeen-piece result separately.
